name: imbas forosnai

attributes.attribute: an Irish Druidic divination system used to find hidden objects and learn secrets
a ritual where the seer chewed raw meat, then slept with palms on cheeks to dream the answer

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Imbas forosnai is an Irish divination system. It is also called imbus forosna or himbas forosnai. The Irish Druids used it. It found hidden or stolen objects. It also learned secrets kept from public knowledge. The term illumination between the hands names the second stage of the ritual. First the bard or seer chewed raw meat. The meat was then offered to the powers of the Otherworld. The answer was to come to the seer by the next day. If it did not, the second stage began. The seer spoke incantations into his or her hands. The seer then slept with palms on cheeks and dreamed the answer.

okr.objective: Document the Irish Druidic divination system imbas forosnai.
key_results: Record its purpose of finding hidden objects and learning secrets.
Explain the term illumination between the hands.
Describe the chewing of raw meat and the dreaming stage.
